headline: Brent Hits $114 per Barrel as Houthi Attacks Threaten Saudi Infrastructure
summary: Brent crude climbed to $114.00 per barrel and WTI reached $100.40 as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia renewed global oil supply concerns.
why: Crude oil is a vital global benchmark for energy costs, transport, and headline inflation worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical strikes against Saudi energy assets trigger supply disruption risk premiums.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Higher benchmark crude prices lift cash flows and profit margins for oil producers.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Spiking crude oil prices push up jet fuel operating expenses.

why_moved: Oil prices surged to $114 per barrel as direct attacks threatened key Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure, elevating supply-interruption fears across global markets.
